usage.selection: Read this compact index first to shortlist styles from metadata.
usage.previews: For title-slide previews, read only the preview.md files for the shortlisted candidates.
usage.final_generation: After the user picks one style, read exactly that style's design.md before generating the full deck.

stage_policy.device_behavior: preserve 16:9 stage on every resolution/aspect ratio; letterbox or pillarbox, never reflow slide content

styles.name: Keynote Noir
styles.tagline: Black stage, white light, one accent. Apple-keynote theatrics: huge type, held pauses, a 'one more thing' finale.
styles.motion: held pauses + single decisive reveals; slam on hero; full omt finale
styles.sound: swoosh on section breaks, chime on the hero number, applause bed under omt
styles.best_for: Product launches, conference keynotes, vision talks, founder pitches, any moment that should feel like a stage and a spotlight. The default better-keynote look.
styles.avoid_for: Dense reading decks, data-heavy internal reviews meant to be read async without a speaker.

styles.name: Spotlight
styles.tagline: Electric blue + gold on deep navy, friendly and high-energy. The LunaTechs stage voice — playful, human, loud.
styles.motion: bouncy staggered builds, jit on a hero word, confetti finish
styles.sound: playful blips on beats, power-up on the hero number, applause + music bed
styles.best_for: Community talks, meetups, teaching, lightning talks, hype/launch moments, anything that wants to feel like a party with a point. The Speaker Playbook's native voice.
styles.avoid_for: Sober institutional finance/legal contexts where the energy would undercut the message.
